verdict.rationale: Mastra supports cron-based schedules to fire workflows/agents (mastra-docs-43, mastra-docs-47), event flow through PubSub (mastra-docs-44), and background/async tool dispatch (mastra-docs-45), which together enable automatic triggering of actions on schedule/events. However, evidence doesn't show a generalized declarative 'rule' engine for arbitrary event conditions beyond cron/pubsub, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific capability. Missing for 10: explicit event-condition rule definitions beyond cron scheduling, webhook/external-event trigger examples, and community validation of automated event-triggered workflows.
